    • CreateNetSMOwithoutQueue

      public static PetriNet CreateNetSMOwithoutQueue(int numChannel, double timeMean, String name) throws ExceptionInvalidNetStructure, ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      Creates Petri net that describes the dynamics of system of the mass service (with unlimited queue)
      Parameters:
      numChannel - the quantity of devices
      timeMean - the mean value of service time of unit
      name - the individual name of SMO
      Returns:
      Petri net dynamics of which corresponds to system of mass service with given parameters
      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - if one of net's transitions has no input position.
      ExceptionInvalidNetStructure

    • CreateNetGenerator

      public static PetriNet CreateNetGenerator(double timeMean) throws ExceptionInvalidNetStructure, ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      Creates Petri net that describes the dynamics of arrivals of demands for service
      Parameters:
      timeMean - mean value of interval between arrivals
      Returns:
      Petri net dynamics of which corresponds to generator
      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - if Petri net has invalid structure
      ExceptionInvalidNetStructure

    • CreateNetFork

      public static PetriNet CreateNetFork(double p1, double p2, double p3) throws ExceptionInvalidNetStructure, ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      Creates Petri net that describes the route choice with given probabilities
      Parameters:
      p1 - the probability of choosing the first route
      p2 - the probability of choosing the second route
      p3 - the probability of choosing the third route
      Returns:
      Petri net dynamics of which corresponds to fork of routs
      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - if Petri net has invalid structure
      ExceptionInvalidNetStructure
